Zapier Integration

Seamlessly send Fathom’s meeting data and insights to thousands of other apps, automating workflows without manual effort.

Overview

Send Fathom’s meeting insights anywhere your team works. With our Zapier integration, you can instantly push highlights, summaries, and action items into thousands of apps – CRMs, task managers, messaging tools, and more. Automate your workflows and cut out the copy-paste.

Popular Use Cases

Automate everything: Instantly push Fathom meeting highlights, summaries, and action items into thousands of apps with no coding.
Eliminate busywork: Cut out the copy-paste and let Zapier move your Fathom data wherever you need it.
Flexible workflows: Customize automations to fit your team’s tools and processes.
